title: 某欧洲大学收到的留学申请来源变化
question: The chart below shows the number of international applicants from four countries that a European university had from 2004 to 2008. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
logic: ▪ 概述 【大部分时间的常胜将军】中国，但总体呈下降趋势（experienced a general downward trend）→ 【一匹 黑马】美国，2008 年超过中国，最终成为第一（overtook China to become the largest group）→ 【常年垫底】 俄罗斯，但2007 年出现短暂猛增（despite a temporary surge） ▪ 主一段 重点对比中国+美国（第一第二）【先建立初始排名】2004 年中国明显高于美国（significantly outnumbering...）→ 【分时间段：2004–2006】中国：连续下降（a continuous decline）vs 美国：先降后反弹 （a drop... followed by a rebound） → 【结果】：两者都约17,500（their figures eventually converged at...）→ 【2006 之后】走势不同（their trends diverged completely）→ 【最终】美国超过中国 ▪ 主二段 日本 + 俄罗斯【先讲趋势最稳定的日本】日本：持续稳定增长（showed a steady upward trend）→ 【倍数总结】最终恰好翻倍（eventually doubled）→ 【再讲常年最小的俄罗斯】俄罗斯：整体人数最少 （contributing the smallest number of applicants overall）→ 先增长又大幅下降

source_nine.en: The column chart illustrates the number of international students from four countries who applied to a university in a European country between 2004 and 2008.
source_nine.cn: 该柱状图展示了2004 年至2008 年间，来自四个国家的国际学生申请某个欧洲国家大学的人数情况。

source_nine.en: Overall, China was the largest source of applicants for most of the period, although the figure experienced a general downward trend over time. In contrast, the number of applicants from the United States fluctuated considerably and eventually overtook China to become the largest group in 2008. Meanwhile, Russia consistently recorded the lowest figures despite a temporary surge in 2007.
source_nine.cn: 总体来看，中国在大部分时间中是最大的留学生来源国，尽管其申请人数整体呈下降趋势。相比之下，美国的申请人 数波动较大，最终在2008 年超越中国，成为最大的生源国。与此同时，俄罗斯的申请人数虽然曾在2007 年短暂激 增，但整体一直处于最低水平。

source_nine.en: In 2004, Chinese applicants stood at approximately 28,000, significantly outnumbering American applicants at 20,000. Over the next two years, China experienced a continuous decline, while the United States saw a drop in 2005 followed by a rebound. Despite their different trends, their figures eventually matched at roughly 17,500 in 2006. Thereafter, their trends diverged completely. The number of Chinese students plateaued in 2007 before falling further to about 15,000 in 2008. The United States, conversely, experienced a sharp drop to 10,000 in 2007, but then the figure soared dramatically to nearly 28,000 in the final year, thereby replacing China as the largest source of applicants.
source_nine.cn: 年，中国申请者约为28,000 人，明显高于美国 的20,000 人。在接下来的两年中，中国申请人数持续下降，而美国则在2005 年出现下降后有所回升。尽管趋势不 同，两国申请人数在2006 年交汇于约17,500 人。此后，两者的走向完全分化。中国申请人数在2007 年趋于平稳， 随后在2008 年进一步下降至约15,000 人。相反，美国申请人数在2007 年急剧下降至10,000 人，但在最后一年猛 增至近28,000 人，从而取代中国成为最大的生源国。

source_nine.en: By comparison, the number of Japanese applicants showed a steady upward trend. Starting at about 5,000 in 2004, the figure increased gradually each year and eventually doubled to reach around 10,000 in 2008. Russia, although contributing the smallest number of applicants overall, experienced a notable rise from roughly 1,000 in 2004 to about 8,000 in 2007, before falling sharply to below 4,000 in the final year.
source_nine.cn: 相比之下，日本申请人数呈现稳步上升的趋势。2004 年最初约为5,000 人，此后逐年增加，最终在2008 年翻倍至约 10,000 人。俄罗斯尽管总体申请人数最少，但从2004 年的约1,000 人显著增长至2007 年的约8,000 人，随后在最 后一年急剧下降至不足4,000 人。

nine.answer: Bicycle ownership among the youngest group stood at around 40%.
